subject: world_language
concept: Understanding humor, wordplay, and cultural allusion in authentic target-language content
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a piece of wordplay or cultural allusion to the explanation of why it's amusing or meaningful
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a described joke, pun, or cultural allusion works in the target language

misconception_flags: translates wordplay literally, missing the linguistic or cultural mechanism that makes it work

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
